motifs.name: left_cliff_rock_bank
motifs.description: Isolate the tall eroded rock bank rising along the left edge, including the sweeping vertical cliff contours, fissures, dark ink accents, root-like base forms, and pale ink washes; exclude seals, the landing structure, boat, and separate leaf sprays where possible.
must_preserve: long tapering cliff outline strokes
thin internal crack lines
soft gray-brown wash texture
dark ink notches and hollows at the base
curving root-like rock forms near the waterline

motifs.name: covered_ferry_boat
motifs.description: Isolate the long covered river boat, including the pointed hull, roofed cabin, railings, posts, oar/pole fittings, and passengers seated or standing on board; exclude nearby landing, foreground rocks, and willow branches not touching the boat.
must_preserve: slender double hull outline
arched canopy roof and scalloped eave marks
rectangular railing and cabin post geometry
fine figure linework inside and beside the cabin
long diagonal boat pole
subtle ink wash on roof and hull

motifs.name: central_low_willow_thicket
motifs.description: Isolate the lower central willow thicket behind and around the boat roof, with rounded clumps of pendant leaves and thin branching stems; exclude the boat cabin and the taller right willow trunks.
must_preserve: rounded masses of drooping leaves
repeated fine leaf strokes
thin forked branch lines
dark ink accents at leaf bases
soft transparent wash within the foliage

motifs.name: right_tall_willow_grove
motifs.description: Isolate the large willow grove on the right, including the tall leaning trunks, arching branches, dense hanging curtains of leaves, and the smaller adjacent tree stems; exclude foreground rocks, boat, seals, and empty paper.
must_preserve: curving trunk outlines with textured bark washes
arching branch structure
long pendant leaf curtains
individual leaf clusters in dark ink
open gaps between foliage masses
subtle tonal variation in trunks and leaves

motifs.name: foreground_rocks_and_shrubs
motifs.description: Isolate the foreground rock garden at the bottom center, including jagged rocks, low shrubs, small leafy plants, and the base of the willow trunk where it joins the rocks; exclude the boat and broad water surface.
must_preserve: angular rock contour lines
wrinkled texture strokes and dark crevices
soft gray-brown rock washes
small clustered shrub leaves
tiny plant stems and ink dots
organic transition into the willow-root base
